# Chapter 10 — Weighted Paths

## Dijkstra
- `dijkstra_shortest_paths(...)`
- `dijkstra_shortest_path(...)`
- Rejects negative edges with witness metadata.

## Bellman-Ford
- `bellman_ford_shortest_paths(...)`
- `bellman_ford_shortest_path(...)`
- Supports negative edges and reports negative-cycle witnesses.

## Unified API
- `weighted_shortest_paths(...)`
- `weighted_shortest_path(...)`
